bean.name: OpenFgaSecurityPolicy
bean.title: Open Fga Security Policy
bean.description: An authorization policy that asks OpenFGA whether a subject has a relation to an object before the part of the route it guards runs. A deny throws CamelAuthorizationException.

apiUrl.description: The base URL of the OpenFGA HTTP API.

storeId.description: The identifier of the OpenFGA store holding the relationship tuples and the authorization model.

authorizationModelId.description: The authorization model revision to evaluate against. Pin it in production: left empty, the store's latest model is used, and that moves whenever a new model is written.

user.description: The subject to authorize, as a Simple expression resolving to an OpenFGA user identifier such as user:${exchangeProperty.CamelKeycloakTokenSubject}. Read it from an exchange property the step that verified the caller set, rather than from a header the caller sent. An exchange whose subject resolves to blank is denied.

object.description: The object being accessed, as a Simple expression resolving to an OpenFGA object identifier such as document:${header.documentId}. Taking it from a header is normal: the caller may say which resource it wants, and the check decides whether it may have it.

relation.description: The relation to demand, such as reader. Keep it literal: it is the permission being demanded, so resolving it from an inbound header would let the caller pick the weakest one the model defines.

contextualTuples.description: Relationship tuples supplied for the duration of one check and never stored, as semicolon-separated user,relation,object triples, each part a Simple expression. A contextual tuple grants exactly like a stored one, so derive it from something the route established, never from caller input.

conditionContext.description: Context the CEL expression of any conditioned relation the check touches is evaluated with, as a map of parameter values. A value written in YAML or a properties file is a string, which OpenFGA rejects for a bool parameter: give that one as #valueAs(boolean):true.

consistency.description: The consistency the check is answered with. Set HIGHER_CONSISTENCY where the window in which a just-revoked tuple can still grant access matters.

apiToken.label: security
apiToken.description: Pre-shared token sent to OpenFGA in the Authorization header, for a server started with --authn-method preshared.

clientId.label: security
clientId.description: Client identifier for the OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow. Setting it selects that flow, so clientSecret, apiTokenIssuer and apiAudience are then required too.

clientSecret.label: security
clientSecret.description: Client secret for the OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow.

apiTokenIssuer.label: security
apiTokenIssuer.description: The token endpoint the client-credentials flow exchanges its credentials at.

apiAudience.label: security
apiAudience.description: The audience to request the access token for in the client-credentials flow.

scopes.label: security
scopes.description: Space-separated scopes to request in the client-credentials flow.

failOpen.label: security
failOpen.description: Whether to let the exchange proceed when OpenFGA could not be asked at all, for example because the server is unreachable. It never applies to a deny, nor to an exchange whose subject or object did not resolve. Do not enable this in production.

connectTimeout.label: advanced
connectTimeout.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds, for the connection to OpenFGA to be established.

readTimeout.label: advanced
readTimeout.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds, for the check to complete once connected. A request that times out is a failure to obtain a verdict rather than a deny, so the exchange is denied unless failOpen is set.

maxRetries.label: advanced
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request that failed in a way worth retrying, such as a rate limit or a 5xx.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: TLS configuration for the connection to OpenFGA, to trust a server whose certificate comes from a private CA or to present a client certificate to one that requires mutual TLS. Takes precedence over useGlobalSslContextParameters.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Whether to use the global SSL context parameters, the context-wide SSLContextParameters camel-main builds from camel.ssl.*, when sslContextParameters is not set.

healthCheckEnabled.label: advanced
healthCheckEnabled.description: Whether to register a readiness check for the OpenFGA server this policy queries. The policy denies every exchange it guards while the server is unreachable, so a route that cannot reach it is not ready.

openFgaClient.label: advanced
openFgaClient.description: An existing OpenFgaClient to use instead of building one from apiUrl, the credentials and sslContextParameters. No readiness check is registered for it.
